method: Ordinary New Game, walk off east side, street landing and approach to unmarked face; real held climb to roof

state.progressLabel: Every building face is climbable. Mint paths teach the route. Hold C / RB / R1 to climb onto a roof.

swing.message: Web released. Release controls, then press again.

traversal.message: Wall held. Up/down climbs; left/right moves sideways. Let go to detach.

combat.message: Pause → Combat Playground to begin. J / K / L / F are combat controls.
